decision: Coverage floor is 75 on all four metrics, measured under vitest 4 AST-aware remapping. The floor is a collapse detector; per-change rigor belongs in the diff gate.

governingRule.description: A coverage percentage is not comparable across instruments

alternativesConsidered.option: Hold 85 and write the tests to reach it under vitest 4
Derive the floor as last-measured minus 2pp, giving branches 79
Flat 80 to match the dart/elixir/julia/kotlin recommendation

whyWinner: Holding 85 means covering about 2500 branches vitest 3 never counted, which is satisfying a ruler rather than reducing risk; percentage-driven tests select for trivial branches and impose refactor drag proportional to count. The derived 79 is self-calibrating but anchored to nothing external, which was the original complaint. 75 is an external published anchor. The same suite reads 85.35 percent branches under vitest 3 v8-to-istanbul and 81.23 percent under vitest 4 ast-v8-to-istanbul, covered branches rising 46194 to 50892 while the denominator grew 54121 to 62651, so the old number was never comparable to the new one.
revisitTrigger: When verify:forward-coverage becomes real diff coverage (#3514), revisit whether 75 is still right; the low floor is justified by a diff gate that does not yet exist at that strength
